title: 1 vs 20 (He Only Brought a Scarf)
altTitles: The Scarf Did Most of the Work
description: Twenty grey inklings. One Bolt. One scarf. #stickfigure #stickfight #animation #shorts
topic: S12 F5 stick-fight Short: Bolt vs 20 grey inklings in a torch-lit arena

sections.label: S1 Hook: the ring closes
sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. <<<image_1>>> BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving. <<<image_7>>> GREY INKLING: a plain black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, steel-grey (#9AA4B2) glowing eyes and rim light, no accessories, twenty of them. Vertical frame. In a torch-lit circular stone arena at night, a ring of twenty grey figures slowly closes in around Bolt at the center; he rolls his shoulders, his scarf lifting in the air, and they all lunge at once. Camera descends in a circle from overhead to low angle, warm torchlight, crimson rim haze. qc: S12: CS4 at 9:16 is unverified — if S1/S2/S3/S5 fail aspect or look, re-roll those sections on hf-seedance-2-5 (SDi 9:16) from a keyframe (KF-S12-01 is already in the script; S2/S3/S5 would need keyframes added) out of the 67s revision budget. Drift — Bolt is the only cyan and the only scarf; grey figures get no accessories. Limbs — HIGHEST-RISK Short: step through every hit in S2/S3; reject any grey figure merging into Bolt. Faces — none expected; check torchlit close-ups. Style — the arena stays 3D. Seam — loop: S6 end ring ≈ S1 start ring (KF-S12-01). Text — arena walls blank. Counter labels are evenly stepped — retime each decrement to the actual defeats after first render. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; stitch seam at 30s: position jump >5% width, lighting flip, prop changing hands, screen-direction reversal = regenerate the later segment; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
